messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-INC-4821 triggered for service inference-ingress-router (us-west1). Symptom: HTTP 5xx error rate spike — 0.4% -> 12% in 3m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Link: https://pd.example/PD-INC-4821 — runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/ingress-error-spike

emma: acked. I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking current autoscale status. tagging @tom for handoff if I need to escalate to infra.

tom: thx. I'm nearby. recommend we check recent deploys and LB connection counts first. if it's KV cache thrash we should limit new canaries.

miguel: seeing correlated kvcache eviction spikes in telemetry (evicts/sec up x6) and auth-proxy token errors in same window. possibly upstream auth rate-limit, not model runtime. pulling proxy logs.

linda: support: 3 customer tickets opened in last 10m saying 502 on generation calls (ACME, Starlite, GreenFin). CC: CSMs pinged. ETA to customer-facing note?

emma: quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n routing ingress-router -o wide` shows X pods Ready/Desired 6/6 but CPU low. LB connections show backlog on a few nodes: `ss -s` shows many CLOSE_WAIT. Running curl test: ```bash
$ curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```.

tom: can we flip traffic away from the two unhealthy nodes? I'll run the drain commands on nodes node-uw1-12 and node-uw1-14 to see if errors reduce. If that helps, we can rotate.

miguel: doing a targeted config bump on auth-proxy to increase connection pools and TTL for tokens (temp). Also increasing kvcache retention window to avoid immediate evictions. Apply in 1m.

pagerbot: Escalation level: SEV2 (manual). On-call: @emma -> acknowledged. Current alerting group: inference-routing.

linda: drafting a short reply for impacted customers: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors for generation endpoints in US-WEST; engineers are mitigating. We will update in 15 minutes." Want approval before posting?

emma: ✅ approve. post it.

tom: drained nodes; immediate drop in 5xx on those nodes. overall error rate down from 12% -> 5% in 2m. continuing observation.

miguel: auth-proxy patch rolled, kvcache tweak applied. still seeing some 502s from a small subset of IPs — likely clients retrying with bad sessions. adding short-term retry-suppression rule at edge.

pagerbot: Alert update: error-rate decaying; will suppress noisy alerts for 10m while we watch. If error-rate stays <2% for 10m, we will auto-close PD-INC-4821.

linda: customer update posted. support queue reduced to 1 active ticket.

emma: handing off to @tom for night coverage at 23:30 UTC. I'm leaving notes in the incident doc (https://wiki.redwood/incidents/PD-INC-4821). key points: drained two nodes, auth-proxy patch, kvcache retention increased, watchlist for client IPs A.B.C.D.

tom: taking handoff. will keep observer awake and will escalate if errors bump >4% again. setting a short-term throttling policy on retries.

pagerbot: PD-INC-4821 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (monitoring). Last update: 1717702330.
